what: round 2 of the set-supervision experiment: set_mass -> uniform_in_set with the corpus, split, hyperparameters, init checkpoint and evaluation held fixed. Tests whether the round-1 failure of -log sum_{a in S} pi(a|s) is specific to that form.

not_r1.what_r1_is: R1 is the retrospective projection of the v4.1.0 WP02 curve that this project never ran

criteria.task: T08 / WP420-02 section 10.6 priority 2: change ONLY the set-loss form

held_byte_identical: training states: 138 train / 40 holdout, ancestor split seed % 5 == 4, states_in_both = []
hyperparameters: seed 0 / 5000 steps / batch 128 / adam lr 1e-4 / weight_decay 0.0 / grad_clip 0.5 / strict determinism / cuda
A1 corpus + captures: the same 178 states / same obs-v3 .npz files
evaluation: tools/rl/v420_eval_shoot.py --shoot-pulse-period 48 --obs-window consecutive, dev seeds 1000-1019, 20 episodes per ruler, stage 0 / normal / max-frames 19887 / cpu / timeout 240
ruler definitions: diag = --stop-on-death, s1n = no stop

loss_forms.set_mass: L = -log sum_{a in S} pi(a|s)   (round 1; default; byte-identical)
loss_forms.uniform_in_set: L = -sum_{a in S} (1/|S|) log pi(a|s)   (this round)
loss_forms.hinge: L = max(0, m - log sum_{a in S} pi(a) + log sum_{a not in S} pi(a)), m = ln 2 frozen

run_plan.train: uniform_in_set only (hinge is not run: uniform_in_set attacks the NAMED mechanism, single-action collapse, most directly)
run_plan.eval: uniform_in_set checkpoint, 2 rulers x 20 dev seeds = 40 episodes, strictly serial, private cp -a data dirs

mechanism.random_reference_definition: mean |S|/18 over the 40 holdout states, i.e. the hit rate of a policy that puts uniform mass on all 18 candidates

no_collapse.rule: the 20 DIAG episodes do NOT all have the same length (at least 3 distinct frame counts) AND the NE share is < 0.50
no_collapse.ne_share_definition: NE (candidate 2) decisions / all decisions, pooled over the 20 DIAG episodes

capability.rule: stage_clear >= 1 over the 40 episodes (diag + s1n together)

frames.rule: diag mean frames >= 1650.4 OR s1n mean frames >= 2824.35
frames.source: R0 (unmodified A0) on the same new instrument, n=20 per ruler (T08 CLEAR_REMEASURE.md)

branches.1: mechanism AND no-collapse both hold  -> the loss form is one cause; worth enlarging the corpus
branches.2: no-collapse only                  -> collapse is a form problem, generalisation is a data problem (two independent defects)
branches.3: mechanism only                    -> the collapse has another cause
branches.4: neither                           -> data scale is the only constraint; another loss form is useless
branches.5: stage_clear >= 1                  -> first capability evidence (still single seed / n=20)

criteria.branch_precedence: 5 first (a clear is the strongest event); otherwise 1-4 from (mechanism, no-collapse)
limits: single training seed (0); n=20 dev episodes per ruler; no interval, no rate estimate
this is not R1 (R1 is the v4.1.0 WP02 curve this project never ran)
the A1 states sit on A0's own TRAIN trajectories at H=120: a diagnostic localisation, not a generalisation corpus
the holdout is a split of the same 178 states, not a development or confirmation split
